legal_units.title: Income not forming part of total income and expenditure in relation to such income.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in this Act, for the purposes of computing the total income under this Chapter, no deduction shall be allowed in respect of expenditure incurred by the assessee in relation to income which does not form part of the total income.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division A Heads of income Section 14 Income not forming part of total income and expenditure in relation to such income. Section 14(1): Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in this Act, for the purposes of computing the total income under this Chapter, no deduction shall be allowed in respect of expenditure incurred by the assessee in relation to income which does not form part of the total income.

legal_units.title: Income not forming part of total income and expenditure in relation to such income.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in this Act, the provisions of this section shall apply in a case where any expenditure has been incurred during any tax year in relation to income which does not form part of the total income under this Act, but such income has not accrued or arisen or has not been received during that tax year.
